title: The City of Dreadful Night
author: James Thomson
description: "The City of Dreadful Night" by James Thomson is a poetic work written during the late 19th century, specifically in the Victorian era.
longDescription: This long poem delves into themes of despair, existential questioning, and the human condition, using the metaphor of a grim city to explore the darker aspects of life and the struggle for meaning amid suffering.

authorInfo.bio: James Thomson (1834–1882) wrote The City of Dreadful Night. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
